One of the Best Vegetarian Restaurants I've Tried
Jun 2026 • Friends
One of the best vegetarian restaurants I've been to. The dishes are creative, fresh, and full of natural flavors. The seasoning is just right,not too strong, and you can really taste the sweetness of the vegetables and other ingredients. Everything was so good that I kept wanting another bite.

The portions are also much bigger than they look on the menu. We thought we didn't order much, but the table ended up full of food and we could barely finish everything. My favorite dish was definitely the fried mushrooms. So crispy and delicious!

Delicious Vegetarian Food and Peaceful Atmosphere
Apr 2025 • Family
had a great experience at Nhà Hàng Chay Từ! The food was fresh, flavorful, and beautifully presented. They offer a wide variety of vegetarian dishes, from traditional Vietnamese flavors to creative modern options. The atmosphere was very peaceful and clean, perfect for relaxing and enjoying a good meal. Staff were polite and attentive without being intrusive. Prices were reasonable considering the quality.
Highly recommend for anyone looking for healthy and delicious vegetarian food in Ho Chi Minh City!
